summary.text: Polly Thomas is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 80 (Jefferson Parish), and was elected in 2016, according to the official House member page. Polly Thomas is vice chair of the Commerce Committee.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Polly Thomas's occupation as Retired.

It lists education as B.A., Speech Pathology and Audiology, University of Southwestern Louisiana, 1969; M.S., Educational Psychology, Texas A&M University, 1974; Ph.D., Educational Psychology, Texas A&M University, 1977.

The page lists committee assignments including Commerce (vice chair), House and Governmental Affairs, Retirement and the House Select Committee on Women and Children, and caucus affiliations including the Jefferson Parish Legislative Delegation, the Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus and the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation.
